title: Percival Lowell's Martian irrigation canals

tellings.quote: on Mars but LEL went as far as to claim that parts of these dark areas and patterns were purposefully built irrigation systems designed by a martian civilization

plain: The astronomer Percival Lowell went so far as to claim that some of the dark areas and lines seen on Mars were irrigation canals built on purpose by a Martian civilization. Michels tells this himself, as part of the history of ideas about life on Mars, without naming a source. If Lowell had been right, Mars would once have held intelligent builders.
